cells.gaps: No source from the last three years has the government both saying digital transformation must be paid for from the country's own resources and acting on it: no fund, levy or assigned tax is shown created, collecting or paying. The 2027 draft budget, 3.8% lower, was not approved in committee (SEN-010) and is read once adopted.
cells.note: The digital budget rose from 2024 to 2025 (SEN-004). The 2027 draft that would cut it was rejected in committee on 13 November 2026 and is not yet a budget, so 3 holds.
